 Brad Underwood’s update on David Mirkovic injury shows he is inching closer to an Illinois basketball return 
 Illinois basketball has been lighting up the scoreboard, but it would be nice to get David Mirkovic back on the court. By Rees Woodcock | Nov 17, 2026, 6:06 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Apr 3, 2026; Indianapolis, IN, USA; Illinois Fighting Illini head coach Brad Underwood talks with forward David Mirkovic (0) during a practice session ahead of the Final Four of the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament at Lucas Oil Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Robert Deutsch-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The 2026-27 season has just been okay thus far for the Illinois basketball program.
--> The 2026-27 season has just been okay thus far for the Illinois basketball program.
 Illinois has only played one real team, Texas Tech, and at one time, we were down by 22 points in the first half. That game ended up being close, but the Illini fell to the Red Raiders .
--> Illinois has only played one real team, Texas Tech, and at one time, we were down by 22 points in the first half. That game ended up being close, but the Illini fell to the Red Raiders .
 The three other games Illinois has played were all blowouts, and Illinois put up over 100 points. Through all of this, we have been without preseason All-American David Mirkovic. On Monday, in the Duke pregame press availability , Brad Underwood gave an update on Mirkovic.
--> The three other games Illinois has played were all blowouts, and Illinois put up over 100 points. Through all of this, we have been without preseason All-American David Mirkovic. On Monday, in the Duke pregame press availability , Brad Underwood gave an update on Mirkovic.
 “Every day is a step closer to him being back in uniform. I watched him shoot today, and he’s not back practicing. He is back lifting weights now, after the appendix, which is a great thing.”
--> “Every day is a step closer to him being back in uniform. I watched him shoot today, and he’s not back practicing. He is back lifting weights now, after the appendix, which is a great thing.”
 The progression is slow, but Mirkovic is inching his way back to being on the court again. It has been a long time since we saw him suit up, which was back in the Final Four last season.
--> The progression is slow, but Mirkovic is inching his way back to being on the court again. It has been a long time since we saw him suit up, which was back in the Final Four last season.
 Underwood did lay out the expectations for Mirkovic’s return.
--> Underwood did lay out the expectations for Mirkovic’s return.
 “I think the one thing we all have to understand is we are 14 or 15 weeks removed from a lot of physical activity. We are not going to bring him back until he is as close to 100%, until he is practicing with our guys, until there is some comfort out there. It’s a step-by-step.”
--> “I think the one thing we all have to understand is we are 14 or 15 weeks removed from a lot of physical activity. We are not going to bring him back until he is as close to 100%, until he is practicing with our guys, until there is some comfort out there. It’s a step-by-step.”
 Mirkovic’s return to the Illinois roster will have enormous benefits. The first being the obvious one: his production. 
--> Mirkovic’s return to the Illinois roster will have enormous benefits. The first being the obvious one: his production. 
 Last season, Mirkovic averaged 13.3 points, 8.0 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game. He was top three on the Illinois roster in all three categories.
--> Last season, Mirkovic averaged 13.3 points, 8.0 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game. He was top three on the Illinois roster in all three categories.
 Illinois needs Mirkovic back for the intangible things, too. His communication on the court is something that Underwood has now mentioned in the last few press availabilities , and it is clearly missing from the Illinois roster. His ability to be the glue guy while also being the best player is a rarity.
--> Illinois needs Mirkovic back for the intangible things, too. His communication on the court is something that Underwood has now mentioned in the last few press availabilities , and it is clearly missing from the Illinois roster. His ability to be the glue guy while also being the best player is a rarity.
 Illinois basketball could be benefiting from the absence of David Mirkovic in a way
--> Illinois basketball could be benefiting from the absence of David Mirkovic in a way
 It has been a struggle at times without Mirkovic on the court. He is such a valuable asset. With that being said, Underwood sees his absence as a way for Illinois to develop as a program.
--> It has been a struggle at times without Mirkovic on the court. He is such a valuable asset. With that being said, Underwood sees his absence as a way for Illinois to develop as a program.
 “Do you wish you had David? Yes, we do, but we don’t. There are a lot of benefits to our team not having him right now and going through the rigors that we are going through, playing the schedule we are playing without him.”
--> “Do you wish you had David? Yes, we do, but we don’t. There are a lot of benefits to our team not having him right now and going through the rigors that we are going through, playing the schedule we are playing without him.”
 Illinois is playing a ton of freshmen, and the crash course into getting them up to speed will only benefit the program down the road. Without Mirkovic on the court, these young players get more playing time in these big moments.
--> Illinois is playing a ton of freshmen, and the crash course into getting them up to speed will only benefit the program down the road. Without Mirkovic on the court, these young players get more playing time in these big moments.
 Eventually, Mirkovic will be back on the court. My guess is the beginning of the Big Ten season. For now, Illinois will continue to develop and maintain a top 25 status as we await the triumphant return of the best player in the country.
